title: Tourism & Attractions Resource
description: Structured schema for tourist attractions, sights, landmarks, museums, and points of interest for natural-language travel queries.

supportedIntents.description: Queries requesting sights, attractions, things to do, landmarks, or specific categories of places to visit in a destination.
example: best places to visit in Kurukshetra

subtypes.description: Specific POI classification, e.g. 'Art Museum', 'Ancient Temple', 'Urban Park', 'Scenic Overlook'.

schema.description: Main query object for tourism discovery.

type.description: Kind of request: 'list' for multiple attractions or 'detail' for specific spot.

filters.description: Filters to narrow down attractions by destination, category, or distance.
